offsetMultiplyAdd.description: Build-time scalar f32 policy for compute-only SPIR-V modules. Fuse (a + b*c) + d as a + fma(b,c,d) while preserving operand evaluation order. Other emitters and mixed-stage modules retain their existing policy.

multiDotLoops.description: Compute-only SPIR-V loop policy. Preserve applies DontUnroll to innermost loops containing multiple emitted OpDot instructions. Preserve-reductions-unroll-independent keeps that protection except for proven independent, bounded local-array element updates, which receive Unroll. Driver-default applies neither hint. Other loops and targets retain their existing controls.
